name: Slovakia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, blue and red, with the coat of arms on the hoist side: a white double cross standing on three blue hills on a red shield edged in white.
flag.symbolism: White, blue and red are pan-Slavic colors; the double cross reflects the Christian heritage brought by Saints Cyril and Methodius, and the three hills are traditionally the Tatra, Fatra and Mátra ranges.

hook: Slovakia's large red shield carries a white double cross on three blue hills; Slovenia's smaller blue shield shows a mountain and stars.
trivia: The flag was adopted in September 1992, a few months before Czechoslovakia peacefully split on 1 January 1993.
Without the shield, Slovakia's flag would be identical to Russia's.
